entities.summary: Pulau Brani is an island located off the southern coast of Singapore, near Keppel Harbour. The island is situated between the main island of Singapore and the resort island of Sentosa, and is linked to the mainland via Brani Terminal Avenue. The area of Pulau Brani is 1.22 square kilometres. The island was previously home for Orang Laut, and in Malay, the meaning of Pulau Brani is “isle of the brave”.
